name: Grizzly Mixpack 9MG
short_description: Now you can enjoy Grizzly’s Mint, Wintergreen, and Southern flavors all in the same 9mg mixpack. Each can contains 20 pouches.
description:
What's Included:

  • 1 can x Grizzly Mint
  • 1 can x Grizzly Wintergreen
  • 1 can x Grizzly Southern

These pouches are considered Strong since they contain 9mg of tobacco-free nicotine. A 12mg Grizzly Mixpack is also available.
